name: refuted-by-shown-guard

finding.title: `Shutdown` and `run` can both close `done`
finding.description: `Shutdown` closes `done` when the subscriber disconnects, and `run` closes it again when the source ends. Closing a closed channel panics, so a disconnect that races the end of the source may crash the process.

checks: internal/stream/stream.go:24 `run` ends it again on return
